What decided it: you cancelled more than 3 minutes after a driver was matched, and the trip record shows the driver had arrived and was waiting nearby before you cancelled. The fee applies from the moment you cancel beyond the grace period, whatever the reason.

There is no action on your account and nothing further is owed on this trip. If you believe something in the record is wrong, you can reply to your dispute confirmation.

What decided it: the rider cancelled more than 3 minutes after being matched, and the records confirm you had arrived and were waiting at the pickup before the cancellation. The $6.61 cancellation fee applies, and it has been added to your earnings as usual.

Nothing is required from you. Thanks for waiting at the pickup and for keeping your location on during the trip.
